authority.binding: Largest matching-lean kernel / matching-autarky reduction is polynomially computable; removed autark clauses preserve satisfiability and witnesses lift by the autark assignment.

interpretation.janus_bridge: AUTARKY IS A SPECIAL CASE OF GROUPED WITNESS-DOMINANCE WITH ONE REPRESENTATIVE BRANCH.
interpretation.strict_extension: JANUS witness-dominance may map one residual witness to another while changing remaining variables; ordinary autarkies do not.
